heading: Accounting and use of appropriations
lead: Funds appropriated each fiscal year pursuant to sections 715k–3 to 715k–5 of this title shall be accounted for, added to, and used for purposes of the migratory bird conservation fund 1 established pursuant to section 718d of this title.

notes.text: Codification Section was not enacted as part of the Migratory Bird Conservation Act which comprises this subchapter.

ancestors.heading: PROTECTION OF MIGRATORY GAME AND INSECTIVOROUS BIRDS
